thread:
erin: FYI during this quarter's least-priv review I noticed an IAM role (projects/ci-prod/roles/ci-runner) bound to 3 external accounts. One looks stale and the role has kmsAdmin permissions.

sam: can you paste the binding? curious which accounts are external.

erin: pasted in the drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/access-reviews/3976543210_ci_role_bindings.txt. gist: 
```
- members: [serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-external.iam.gserviceaccount.com, user:old-hs@vendor.com, serviceAccount:orphan@external.org]
  role: roles/cloudkms.admin
```

rachel: oh no. old-hs@vendor.com is a contractor who left last year. orphan@external.org is weird  not in our allowlist.

tom: blocking: that role can regrant keys. we need to lock it down fast. plan: 1) revoke external bindings, 2) attach a temporary scoped role to the CI runners, 3) rotate impacted KMS keys, 4) require attestation from platform team.

erin: +1 but we should avoid breaking CI pipeline this afternoon. suggest maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC and create a fallback key.

security-bot: [policy] External service accounts must be validated with SecEng lead before being granted kmsAdmin. Unverified external principals flagged.

sam: I can automate the removal of non-allowlisted members in a patch PR. will run in a dry-run and output CC list.

ci-bot: CI run queued: `access-review/rm-external-bindings` -> dry-run passed 12 items (no-op).

rachel: tom please confirm the fallback key approach. we need to ensure backups and snapshot workflows still decrypt.

tom: fallback approach: create key-rotated-temp in the same keyring, update CI pipeline env var KMS_KEY to temp, run smoke-tests, then rotate callers to stable key, and finally delete external bindings. rollback: revert env var.

erin: evidence for audit: include commit that added binding + last-used logs. I found a PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/ae12f. attaching to SecTracker later.

sam: adding ticket template fields: requester, affected_keys, dry_run_output_link, maintenance_window, attestation_link. Also add label `requires-sec-eng-approval` for external removals.

security-bot: reminder: emergency removal of principal with cross-account grants requires 2 approvals. Use `emergency-revoke` workflow only after approval.

oncall-bot: creating monitor for rotated-key: "kms-rot-3976543210" -> alerts to eng-oncall if >3 failed decrypts in 5m.

rachel: can we add a log filter to capture `PermissionDenied` errors to a temp log group for 48h? that'll make RCA easier if something breaks.

tom: yes. I'll add a log sink and retention 14d. will share the filter expr in the runbook.

erin: timeline: sam will open the PR today (dry-run), tom will provision temp key and run smoke-tests in the 02:00-03:00 UTC window, rachel will prepare attestation and evidence bundle, sam+erin will get SecEng approval. If unclaimed by EOD+3, escalate to SecEng lead for emergency revoke.

sam: filing PR now -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4829 (WIP). comments welcome.

erin: thanks. please ping here when PR merges. :pray:
